text: In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her.
translation: 在2006年的电影版《穿普拉达的女魔头》中，梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯利训斥她那相貌平平的助理，因为助理自以为高级时尚与她毫无干系。
syntaxAnalysis: 句子的主干为 Miranda Priestly ... scolds her unattractive assistant。played by Meryl Streep 为过去分词短语作插入语修饰主语；介词短语 for imagining ... 作原因状语，其中 that 引导宾语从句 high fashion doesn't affect her。

text: Priestly explains how the deep blue color of the assistant's sweater descended over the years from fashion shows to department stores and to the bargain bin in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment.
translation: 普里斯利解释了这位助理所穿毛衣的深蓝色是如何在过去几年间，从顶级时装秀逐级流向百货商店，再流落到特价卖场——而这个可怜的女孩无疑正是从那里的折价筐中淘到了这件衣服。
syntaxAnalysis: 主干为 Priestly explains how ...。how 引导宾语从句，从句主语为 the deep blue color ...，谓语为 descended，接地点状语 from ... to ... and to ...；定语从句 in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment 修饰先行词 bargain bin。

text: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
translation: 时装界这种自上而下的传统观念早已彻底过时，且与伊丽莎白·克莱恩在《过度装扮》中所描绘的狂热世界格格不入——该书是她历时三年对‘快时尚’发起的一记沉重控诉。
syntaxAnalysis: 主句主干为 This top-down conception ... couldn't be more out of date or at odds with ...。couldn't be more + adj. 表最高级含义（极其/再没有比这更...）；described in Overdressed 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 world；Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment ... 为 Overdressed 的同位语。

text: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
translation: 在过去十年左右的时间里，技术的进步使Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众平价品牌能够更迅速地对潮流做出反应，并更精准地预判市场需求。
syntaxAnalysis: 主句主干为 advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels ... to react to ... and anticipate ...。such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 labels；两个并列的不定式短语充当 allow 的宾语补足语。

text: Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit.
translation: 更快的货品周转意味着更少的库存浪费、更频繁的新品发售以及更丰厚的商业利润。
syntaxAnalysis: 简单句。主语为 Quicker turnarounds，谓语动词为 mean，三个并列名词短语 less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit 构成复合宾语。

text: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable — meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that — and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
translation: 这些品牌怂恿具有时尚意识的消费者将服装视为一次性用品——哪怕它们并不会公开做此类广告宣传，衣服设计初衷往往也只耐洗一两次——并诱导大家每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。
syntaxAnalysis: 主干为 These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see ... and to renew ...。破折号内 meant to last ... 为过去分词短语作补充说明，内嵌 although 引导的让步状语从句；两个并列的不定式短语作为 encourage 的宾语补足语。

text: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
translation: 克莱恩认为，通过以极其低廉的白菜价提供紧跟潮流的单品，这些品牌实质上劫持了时尚周期，彻底震颤并重塑了这个长期习惯于按季度运转的行业。
syntaxAnalysis: By offering ... 为方式状语；Cline argues 为插入语；主句主干为 these brands have hijacked fashion cycles；现在分词短语 shaking an industry ... 作伴随状语/结果状语，后接过去分词短语 long accustomed to ... 修饰 industry。

text: The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers.
translation: 当然，这场快时尚革命的受害者绝不仅限于设计师群体。
syntaxAnalysis: 主系表结构。主语为 The victims of this revolution，of course 为插入语，谓语为 are not limited to，宾语为 designers。

text: For H&M to offer a $ 5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
translation: 若要让H&M在全球2300多家门店中供应售价仅为5.95美元的针织超短裙，它就必须仰仗海外低薪廉价劳工、以足以耗竭自然资源的体量大批下单，并耗用海量有害化学原料。
syntaxAnalysis: 句首 For H&M to offer ... 为不定式复合结构作目的/条件状语；主句由三个并列的谓语动词短语构成：must rely on ..., order in volumes that strain ..., and use ...；其中 that strain natural resources 为定语从句修饰 volumes。

text: Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma.
translation: 《过度装扮》堪称时尚界的重磅力作，它呼应了迈克尔·波伦《杂食者的杂食困境》等针对消费者运动的畅销反思之作。
syntaxAnalysis: 主系表结构。主语为 Overdressed，系动词 is，表语为 the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers，介词短语 like ... 作后置定语举例修饰 bestsellers。

text: “Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful,” Cline argues.
translation: 克莱恩直言：“流水线量产的成衣如同垃圾快餐，固然能填补一时之饥与物欲，但极不耐用且造成惊人的浪费。”
syntaxAnalysis: 直接引语充当宾语。引语主语为 Mass-produced clothing，like fast food 为介词短语插入语，谓语由并列的 fills a hunger and need 和 is non-durable and wasteful 构成；Cline argues 为主谓倒装说明话语来源。

text: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year — about 64 items per person — and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
translation: 她调查发现，美国人每年大约购买200亿件衣服——人均多达64件——而且无论他们捐赠送出多少，这种过度消费最终都无可避免地走向生态浪费。
syntaxAnalysis: 主干并列句。前半句 Americans ... buy roughly 20 billion garments a year（破折号内为同位语解释）；后半句由让步状语从句 no matter how much they give away 与主句 this excess leads to waste 构成；she finds 为插入语。

text: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes — and beautifully.
translation: 在《过度装扮》的收尾部分，克莱恩引出了自己心中的理想典范——一位名叫莎拉·凯特·博蒙特的布鲁克林女性，她自2008年起便纯手工缝制所有个人衣物，且款式极为精美。
syntaxAnalysis: 主干为 Cline introduced her ideal。a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont 为 ideal 的同位语；who 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 Beaumont，从句内嵌破折号强调副词 and beautifully。

text: But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.
translation: 但正如克莱恩自己率先指出的那样，博蒙特花费了数十年时间才磨砺出精湛的制衣手艺；她的个体范例绝不可能被普通人轻易山寨复制。
syntaxAnalysis: 并列复合句。as Cline is the first to note 为非限制性定语/方式从句；前分句 it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft 为 it 代替不定式的经典句型；分号连接后分句 her example can't be knocked off（knock off 熟词僻义：仿制/廉价复制）。

text: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment — including H&M, with its Conscious Collection line — Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
translation: 尽管有几家快时尚公司已经采取措施试图遏制对劳工和生态环境的负面冲击——例如H&M推出了主打环保意识的‘Conscious Collection’系列——但克莱恩坚信，真正持久的变革唯有由消费者亲自驱动促成。
syntaxAnalysis: 主从复合句。Though 引导让步状语从句，破折号包括介词短语 including ... 作补充说明；主句主干为 Cline believes ...，后接省略 that 的宾语从句 lasting change can only be effected by the customer（effect 在此用作及物动词：引起/使发生）。

text: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
translation: 她身上流露出了许多可持续发展倡导者共有的理想主义色彩，无论在食品领域还是在能源领域皆是如此。
syntaxAnalysis: 主谓宾结构。主语 She，谓语 exhibits，宾语 the idealism；common to ... 为形容词短语作后置定语修饰 idealism；be it in food or in energy 为让步状语结构（虚拟语气倒装，相当于 whether it be ...）。

text: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
translation: 虚荣爱美乃是人性中恒久不变的常态；大众只有在自身承受不起不这么做的严重后果（或承受不起劣质恶果/经济代价）时，才会真正开始转向更加环保可持续的消费模式。
syntaxAnalysis: 分号连接的并列复合句。前句 Vanity is a constant 为主系表结构；后句为主从复合句，主句 people will only start shopping more sustainably，when 引导时间/条件状语从句 they can't afford not to (shop sustainably)（双重否定：当负担不起不环保的代价时）。
